ws3Scan.role: exact frontend frame interval plus bounded row-activation event

ws4Response.role: continuous per-channel state and replaceable segment rates

azimuth.policy: inherit the source specimen orientation represented by the WS1 LUT; the source does not provide a numeric azimuth, so none is invented

referenceCondition.geometryApplication: The WS1 LUT already contains the accepted fixed-geometry reflectance. WS5 applies no second MRS, BRDF, angle-gamma, glare, or reflector gain.

stateAndRateContract.initialState: previous committed frame-boundary WS4 continuous RGB command coordinate
stateAndRateContract.target: uncorrected current or previous RGB555 source code divided by 31
stateAndRateContract.rateLifetime: freeze the packed WS4 R32F rate for each constant-target segment
stateAndRateContract.unchangedChannel: retain its first-segment rate across the row split so an unrelated channel change cannot alter its dynamics
stateAndRateContract.endpoint: apply the WS4 exact-target snap only at a segment boundary; integrate the unsnapped continuous trajectory inside the segment
stateAndRateContract.units: dimensionless command state and reciprocal seconds; no voltage or luminance claim

scanIntegration.equation: previous target applies on [0, activation); current target applies on [activation, frame)
scanIntegration.noScanDiagnostic: current RGB555 target applies for the full frame with the same response and color equations

opticalIntegration.output: one native-frame time average of X/Y/Z absolute relative reflectance

cpuGoldReference.method: split at every crossed WS1 LUT cell boundary, expand the trilinear basis into exponentials, and integrate each term analytically

futureShaderContract.panelAllocation: ceil(32 * segmentSeconds / frameSeconds) for each nonzero segment

opticalIntegration.ordering: evaluate WS1 color at every optical-state sample, then integrate XYZ; never evaluate the LUT only once at the average RGB state
opticalIntegration.blackPolicy: the WS1 measured-constrained absolute black remains inside every LUT sample

outputModes.units: absolute relative-reflectance XYZ under the accepted D65 integration

outputModes.equation: exact WS1 LUT texel at current RGB555

validationContract.curatedTransitions: full-scale rise/fall, adjacent gray rise/fall, mixed RGB, primary exchange, and partial-channel change

exclusions: Shader or preset creation before WS8
a second 45-degree gamma, MRS gain, BRDF, glare, or reflector correction
host wall-clock scaling of the native CGB panel interval
